title: What's on the agenda as Macron meets Meloni for rare summit?
summary: Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is set to meet French President Emmanuel Macron Thursday in a bid to tighten ties. Their relationship thus far has been marked by political differences, but Meloni's rift with US leader Donald Trump and shared interests are drawing the two leaders together.
